title: Polio, staying close to his father, and banging on the piano
summary: He was a polio victim who never worked, travelled everywhere with his father, and his father tolerated the noisy practising.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And your cousins played. So which side of the family did they connect you to?
Were they from your mother's side?

No, no, they were from my daddy's side. Distant cousins from my daddy's side. And, well, we were, from what I know, I knew more about the family in a way than Sylvester and Cal. They were just other school and go. Well, I hate to say it, well, I can't help it. But I'm a polio victim. I never did work. My daddy didn't want me to work. He didn't want me to get married. And he, they just, anyway, everywhere my daddy had gone, I had to be right there. And, uh.

Mm-hmm. So what happened, that's why I know more about the family than Sylvester and Cal because they were just happy-go-lucky. When they get finished working, they just, my daddy let them go. But everywhere he went, I was right there. Come on, get on the wagon and go with me. Or come go this place. Or come, he was amusing me. He didn't allow me to wrestle. He didn't allow me to do this. That's the only thing I see. I wish they should have did. Oh, not change one for the other though.

I suppose he hadn't been so interested in the music. That wasn't the idea. That wasn't the idea. It was the idea of letting me exercise more. You understand? But he kept me with that music. And he bought, uh, piano. Every time I turned around, I would bang, on the piano.
Did you hear Dick just then?
I did. He's great. Thank you.
He was trying to convince me that was a whole piece.

I was bang, bangin' on the piano. Well, there's one thing I will give my daddy. He never did say that annoy me. Don't do this and don't do that. I used to hear a clap, uh, Cap. Used to make me angry. Blang, with the clarinet, you know. I said, I wish my daddy would stop it. But he knew that's how he had to learn. He let Cap do the same thing. He let Sylvester do the same thing.
